notes.title: House sitter escape game 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am excited to announce a major update for House Sitter Escape Game!

In preparation of the next escape game, a multiplayer mode has been added to the game, you can now play up to 4 players ! The rooms have also been upgraded to refine the environments. I hope you like it, don't hesitate to share your feedback to better improve this game and the next ones.

Thank you for playing!
Emiguéma Studio
